text:
Sam (CS): quick weekly check-in for BlueHarbor private VPC deployment — TL;DR: region health, KMS/HSM notes, onboarding blockers, and a potential renewal flag. anyone with updates?

Ajay (SRE): NA: 7d uptime 99.97. p50 22ms p95 110ms. Wed 03:12 UTC spike from provider bgp flap, mitigated by failover.

Lisa (Eng): KMS key rotation kicked Mon 04:00 UTC. hit intermittent 5xx where alias hadn't propagated to proxies. patch deployed to proxy layer, monitoring. if you see `kms error: access_denied` ping me.

Kevin (BlueHarbor): yesterday two producer jobs hit HSM read limit -> 429s. caused two client retries to fail. opened internal incident on our side.

Sam (CS): thanks Kevin. logged ticket CS-4372. Ajay / Lisa — options: raise HSM soft limit temporarily or add client-side retries + backoff?

Ajay (SRE): can bump soft limit x2 for 72h for BlueHarbor, will do now and monitor kv metrics. also adding short retry header at edge. ETA ~30m.

Lisa (Eng): pushed retry policy to service config: `retries: {max:3, backoff:200ms}`. rolling out as canary now.

deploy-bot: Deployment 2026-03-18T14:12:34Z completed — service: bh-kms-proxy v2.1.3 (canary -> 10%).

Kevin (BlueHarbor): latency looks improved already. one business question: can you give a 30d spend forecast? we may hit our committed cap early.

Sam (CS): on it. i'll pull last 30d usage + projection and post by noon PT.

Ajay (SRE): EU region note: Thu 01:10 UTC saw ~0.6% packet loss for ~2h due to transit provider maintenance. route reroute reduced impact. uptime hit ~0.01%. logs show repeated `ERR_CONN_RESET`. snippet:```
2026-03-18T01:12:05Z ERROR ERR_CONN_RESET peer=10.4.2.8
2026-03-18T01:12:06Z ERROR ERR_CONN_RESET peer=10.4.2.8
```

Lisa (Eng): onboarding status: 80% complete. remaining: audit log ingestion setup + billing export. Kevin, do you have an SFTP endpoint for audit exports?

Kevin (BlueHarbor): audit team needs SFTP endpoint + creds. I'll send contact details offline.

Sam (CS): noted. also flagging potential renewal risk: usage trending +15% MoM; if trend continues they exceed commit before renewal. i'll put an upsell/renewal note for next Fri sync.

Ajay (SRE): i'll open a provider ticket re: EU transit and request SLA credit if degradation recurs.

Sam (CS): action items recap: 1) Ajay bump HSM soft limit x2 for 72h + monitor (in progress) 2) Lisa confirm retry rollout + follow-up on queuing if HSM still saturated 3) Sam post spend forecast by noon PT 4) Kevin share SFTP contact for audit exports. reply here when done. :thumbsup:

Lisa (Eng): rollback plan in place if retry rollout causes issues. will post perf delta in ~45m.

Ajay (SRE): HSM limit bumped, monitoring dashboards updated -> watch `hsm_reads` and `hsm_429s`.

Kevin (BlueHarbor): received, thanks all. Sam, appreciated if you can include forecast + quick pricing options in the post.

Sam (CS): will do. closing notes: overall healthy but watch HSM and EU transit. next full health sync in 7 days or earlier if any regressions.
